@graph.name: 7 Help Scout Alternatives for Support Teams

mainEntity.name: What is the closest alternative to Help Scout?

acceptedAnswer.text: Front is the closest shared-inbox comparison because it focuses on collaborative customer messages. Freshdesk is a better first comparison when the team wants structured ticketing and a customer portal. The right choice depends on the workflow, not only the brand.

mainEntity.name: Is there a free Help Scout alternative?

acceptedAnswer.text: Zoho Desk lists a free edition for up to three agents. Several products offer trials rather than permanent free plans. Check whether the free tier includes the inbox, channels and customer history your team needs.

mainEntity.name: Can I move Help Scout data to Front?

acceptedAnswer.text: Front documents a Help Scout importer for inboxes, teammates, tags, contacts and messages. It does not import notes or comments, and the importer is not actively maintained. Front recommends migration partners for a more complete move.

mainEntity.name: Does Help Scout import tickets from other help desks?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Its official import guide lists several supported sources, including Freshdesk and Zendesk. It does not import every user setting, knowledge article, saved reply, automation or custom field.

mainEntity.name: Is Intercom cheaper than Help Scout?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not by seat price alone. Intercom shows a new-customer Essential promotion and charges separately for Fin outcomes and some channels. Help Scout charges per user and lists Envoy by resolution. Compare the full seat count and usage estimate.
